∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] {r : Nat} {d : Fin r → Nat} {X : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} X]
  [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} k X] [inst_3 : Module.{u_1, u_2} (MatProd.{u_1} k d) X]
  [inst_4 : IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_1, u_2} k (MatProd.{u_1} k d) X] {n : Nat}
  (yb : Module.Basis.{0, u_1, max u_2 u_1} (Fin n) k (Module.Dual.{u_1, u_2} k X)) (a : Fin n → MatProd.{u_1} k d),
  Eq.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)}
    (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)} (toDualHom.{u_1, u_2} yb) a)
    (Finset.sum.{0, max u_1 u_2} Finset.univ.{0} fun l =>
      HSMul.hSMul.{u_1, max u_1 u_2, max u_1 u_2} (a l)
        (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), 1, max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)} yb l))
